quotes.q: Anilax did not just sell software — they sat with our operations team, mapped AePS flows, and stayed on call during go-live week.
Sandbox keys on day one, clear docs, and webhook signatures that just worked — our integration time dropped by half.
Weekly demos meant we could show the board real progress. Security review passed before marketing spend went live.
They migrated our Excel chaos into one portal. Teachers, parents, and accounts finally spoke the same language.

faqs.q: How do you ensure the system actually reduces manual work?
faqs.a: We start with your workflows — mapping where work repeats, where decisions depend on people, and where delays happen. Then we design systems that trigger actions automatically, standardize decisions, and remove unnecessary steps.

faqs.q: Do we need to rebuild everything or can you work with existing systems?
faqs.a: In most cases, you don't need a rebuild. We typically integrate with your current ERP/CRM, fix broken workflows, and layer automation on top. Rebuilding is only recommended when the current system blocks growth.

faqs.q: How fast can we integrate the API?
faqs.a: Most teams ship a sandbox integration in 1–2 days using our REST API or Node/Python SDKs. Production go-live typically takes 2–4 weeks including KYC and bank partner setup.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing team or developers?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly embed alongside in-house teams — reviewing existing code, filling capability gaps, or taking ownership of specific modules while your developers focus elsewhere.

Every engagement is scoped around your workflows, not a template. After discovery, we outline what the work involves, what it will cost, and how we would phase it — clearly defined before anything starts.

faqs.q: Is my data and idea secure?
faqs.a: Yes. We follow NDA agreements, secure development practices, and controlled access systems. You retain full code ownership and complete IP rights.
